ability.rites_and_paths.beast_lore.desc: You learn the shapes of animals and beasts. Study: hold right click with a Study Book on a living creature until the bar fills (taking damage resets it; the book is used up when you finish). Ritual: cast the Druid's Ritual spell (no scroll needed, it is always on your wheel) on the remains of a freshly killed beast. Each one gives a knowledge point for its species, and each creature can only be studied once and used in a ritual once. Stronger species need more points. What you learn is kept when you reset your class.
ability.rites_and_paths.beast_lore.name: Beast Lore
ability.rites_and_paths.dominate_beast.d: The animal of a species you know that you are looking at obeys you as a pet for a few minutes: it follows you and attacks your enemies (if it can attack). Usable while transformed.
ability.rites_and_paths.entangling_vines: Vines sprout from the ground around you for a while: your allies (and you) slowly heal inside them, and enemies walking over them are slowed and hurt as they move, like in a berry bush. You must leave your form to use it.
ability.rites_and_paths.track_prey.desc: Nearby beasts glow for a few seconds (only for you). If you pin a species in the bestiary, you only see that one, and from farther away. Usable while transformed.
ability.rites_and_paths.track_prey.name: Track Prey
ability.rites_and_paths.wild_shape.desc: Opens the bestiary so you can pick a species you know: after casting for a few seconds (taking damage interrupts it) you turn into it. You pay mana based on how strong the beast is and, while you keep the form, that mana does not regenerate. You get the beast's health, size, speed and attacks, stronger the higher your level; your equipment is hidden and does not count, you cannot use items or cast spells, and your race traits are suspended. If the beast falls, you return to your form with the health you had. Press again (while crouching, instantly) to return to your form; the cooldown starts then. Sleeping, dying or logging out also returns you.
ability.rites_and_paths.wild_shape.name: Wild Shape
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.ferocity.de: Your beast forms have more health and deal more damage.
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.lore.desc: You study faster, you have more time for the ritual and, with the branch full, each species needs one knowledge point less.
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.lore.name: Lore
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.roots.desc: You regenerate health while you are a beast and heal when you return to your form.
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.roots.name: Roots
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.sap.desc: More power for your nature school spells.
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.sap.name: Sap
branch.rites_and_paths.druid.wild_reserv: Transforming costs less mana and you have more max mana.
class.rites_and_paths.druid.desc: Nature mage who turns into the beasts they know. They study living creatures with their book and perform a ritual on their remains to learn their shape; once they know a species well they can become it, with its body, health and attacks. The nature school is theirs: every other school loses 35%, and they are very clumsy with weapons, armor and shields.
class.rites_and_paths.druid.name: Druid
class.rites_and_paths.druid.trait: Class trait: slightly less max health.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.echolocati: Nearby creatures glow for a few seconds (only for you).
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.inflate.de: You swell up for a few seconds: enemies that touch you are poisoned.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.leap.desc: You leap high onto the enemy you are looking at and, landing near it, stun it for a moment.
You regenerate quickly and enemies stop chasing you.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.pounce.des: You lunge forward; your next bite shortly after deals more damage.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.ram.desc: You charge forward and launch the first enemy you hit into the air.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.roar.desc: You weaken and push back nearby enemies.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.shell.desc: You hide in your shell: you take much less damage, but move very slowly.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.sting.desc: You sting the enemy in front of you and poison it.
You stun nearby enemies (bosses, for less time).
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.tongue.des: You grab a small creature with your tongue and pull it closer.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.toss.desc: You toss the enemy in front of you upward.
druid.rites_and_paths.ability.web.desc: You shoot a web at what you are looking at: it leaves a cobweb for a few seconds.
druid.rites_and_paths.part.slot.head: Head (attack)
effect.rites_and_paths.flesh_price.descr: Price of Flesh (Sculptor Druid): you paid for a chimera's ritual in blood; your max health is 30% lower while it lasts.

jei.rites_and_paths.info.beast_head: Sculptor Druid beast part: you get it by choosing it after the Druid's ritual on the remains of a species you already know. It goes in the Flesh Vessel.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.flesh_altar: Sculptor Druid: drop a complete Flesh Vessel on it and right click it for the creation ritual. It costs a lot of mana and lowers your max health for a while.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.flesh_vessel: Sculptor Druid: right click to open it and put in four beast parts (head, torso, legs and instinct). With all four, throw it onto a Flesh Altar and right click the altar to create a chimera.
jei.rites_and_paths.info.study_book: Druid: hold right click while aiming at a living animal or beast to study it; if you take damage, the study starts over. When finished, the book is used up and you gain knowledge of its species. Each creature can only be studied once.

spell.rites_and_paths.druid_ritual.guide: On the remains of a freshly killed beast: you learn a little more about its species (one knowledge point). Druid only.
subclass.rites_and_paths.moon_circle.des: Circle of the Moon Druid: transforms in an instant, with almost no cooldown, and their forms do not reserve mana.
subclass.rites_and_paths.sculptor.desc: Dark rituals: tears parts from beast remains (head, torso, legs and instinct), joins them in a Flesh Vessel and, on a Flesh Altar, brings to life a chimera they can turn into. Each creation costs a lot of mana and part of their health for a while.
subclass.rites_and_paths.sculptor.name: Sculptor
subclass.rites_and_paths.supernatural_fo: A beast that works magic: can cast nature spells while transformed, although their forms are somewhat weaker and those spells cost more.
